about: Golden vectors for web/config.js: the tasak server must give exactly configJs or exactly these errors, in this order. env is the .env text (null = no .env), processEnv the process environment; logos are looked up in web/. Rewrite only on purpose.

cases.name: the example .env
cases.env:
# Copy this file to .env, adjust it and run: tasak build (it generates web/config.js)
#
# The values below are a working example: the Kmbalache 🇨🇺 Mostro node, run by the
# Cuba Bitcoin community. Replace them with your own node, relays, currency and community.

# Site name (logo, browser tab and icon) and name of the rate shown on the page.
# If the name ends in capitals (tasaK), that part is highlighted in the logo.
SITE_NAME=tasaK
RATE_NAME=Tasa K
# Site logo (file in web/, next to index.html, or https link). Empty = the name as text.
LOGO=tasak-logo-dark.svg
# Logo for the light theme (optional; if missing, LOGO is used)
LOGO_LIGHT=tasak-logo-light.svg
# Browser tab icon (svg, png or ico file in web/, not named favicon.svg). Empty = the capitals at the
# end of SITE_NAME (K), generated by tasak as favicon.svg.
FAVICON=

# Default theme: light or dark. Empty = the system theme. Visitors can switch it (☀ / ☾).
THEME=

# Default language: es or en. Empty = the browser language. Visitors can switch it (ES | EN).
LANGUAGE=

# Mostro nodes to show: pubkey in hex or npub, comma separated (required)
MOSTRO_PUBKEYS=00000235a3e904cfe1213a8a54d6f1ec1bef7cc6bfaabd6193e82931ccf1366a

# Relays to connect to, comma separated (required; wss:// only; usually the ones the node uses)
RELAYS=wss://relay.mostro.network,wss://nos.lol,wss://mostro-p2p.tech,wss://relay.shadowbip.com

# Currency shown on load (code: CUP, VES, ARS…). Empty = the most traded one on the node.
FIAT=CUP

# Time zone for dates and candles (e.g. America/Caracas). Empty = the visitor's browser time zone.
TIMEZONE=America/Havana

# Payment methods that don't count by default (comma separated). Each currency's methods come from
# the Mostro app; anything not on its list is «Otros» (other). Pruebas = test orders.
# Add the ones that trade at a different rate in your market or are used by mistake (e.g. «Saldo
# móvil» and «Tarjeta Clásica» in Cuba), with their full name as in the app's list.
HIDDEN_PAYMENT_METHODS=Saldo móvil,Tarjeta Clásica,Pruebas,Otros

# Community running the node and its social links (optional; the node doesn't publish them on Nostr).
# Only shown for the nodes in this .env, not when someone switches node in the URL.
COMMUNITY=Cuba Bitcoin
COMMUNITY_URL=https://cubabitcoin.org
SOCIAL_LINKS=https://t.me/Cuba_Bitcoin,https://t.me/CUBA_lnp2p,https://x.com/Cuba_BTC,https://www.youtube.com/@CubaBitcoin21,https://github.com/Cuba-Bitcoin,https://primal.net/p/npub1huyn6ru55pv6l7p0sxvlu3vfpq7pan958sl4weft0kte6lvdvvksd5s34t

# The tasaK server (tasak) archives the node's events in ARCHIVE_DIR/tasak.sqlite (optional; default
# data/, relative to the repository folder). ARCHIVE=false serves the site without archiving.
ARCHIVE_DIR=
ARCHIVE=

# Address the tasaK server (server/) listens on (optional; default 127.0.0.1:8765).
# To publish, put a web server with HTTPS (nginx, Caddy…) in front of it.
LISTEN=

# The Tasa K the server publishes: web/api/tasa.json and, with a signing key, a signed Nostr event.
# SIGNING_KEY_FILE: a file with the key (create it with `tasak keygen FILE`), outside the repository and
# readable only by you; a key only for this, not the node's. Empty = the rate isn't signed.
SIGNING_KEY_FILE=
# Decimals of the published rate (0 to 8; default 2)
RATE_DECIMALS=
